item.tib: mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi dbang bzhi bsgrub rim pa las yang gsang ye shes rang shar
item.coloph: ces mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi yang gsang lhan cig skyes pa ston pa tshig dbang rin po che ye shes rang shar 'di ni/ khro chen rgyal po siNah+ya'i (siNah+yas) zhabs bsti ches cher mdzad cing bskyar ngor/ skal ldan mched grogs slob ma rnams kyis (kyi) snying gi nor mchog dam pa ru shar phyogs rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing khams byang phyogs ngo mtshar nor bu'i gling du kun grol gyis brtsams pa'o/
